items.question: Why treat artifacts as part of trust?
items.answer: Because continuity is verifiable where marketing is not. A physical Booking.com plaque from 2015, an editorial guidebook citation, a national press article, and a government PT registration all point to the same address and the same founder — an evidence trail a traveller can cross-check, not a claim they have to take on faith.

items.question: Does JVTO assert a specific incorporation year?
items.answer: No. JVTO's brand and operation date from 2015 (the guesthouse era), and the PT was formalized in 2023 — evidenced by the TDUP tourism licence issued 2023-02-11 and NIB 1102230032918. JVTO does not assert a separate PT incorporation date, because no authoritative incorporation document supports one.
